summary: Getty Images Holdings filed an 8-K/A on July 7, 2026, amending its prior filing to disclose termination of the Agreement and Plan of Merger with Shutterstock. The board resolved not to accept a condition requiring sale of Shutterstock's editorial business to secure UK CMA clearance, leading to termination after the July 6, 2026 extended end date. Getty delivered a written termination notice on July 7. No deal terms are restated here; there is no break fee mentioned. Following termination, Getty's 10.500% senior secured notes due 2030 will be redeemed per their indenture. Watch for any litigation or revised regulatory strategy.
